name: saas-rebuild
description: Replace SaaS you don't control. Tear down an app you administer - extraction recipes for the 100 most-adopted SaaS apps built in, five-plane data extraction, audit-log process mining, evidence-cited verdicts, a full-tenant preservation export, and a dependency-graph-derived rebuild plan validated by transaction replay, emitting a supervised training-pair corpus - and run U.S. restricted-party screening on premise: deterministic matching, hash-chained audit trail, zero dependencies.
